action.description: Registry name from action.list, e.g. points.transfer

input.description: The action's input object (its input_schema). Omit when committing with a preview_token.

dry_run.description: Mutating actions: true returns a preview with preview_token and decision; nothing is written.

preview_token.description: Commit exactly what the dry run previewed (single use, valid 300 s).

reason.description: a string at most 280 character(s) long
reason.title: maxLength(280)

ActionInvokeInput.description: Reads: {action, input}. Writes: {action, input, dry_run: true} then {action, preview_token, idempotency_key}.
